context: Two adults reflect on a class reunion event
purpose: Teach: 堂々/気づく/防災/再会/新刊/特典/二度と/柔軟

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 昨日の同窓会、二十年ぶりの再会で本当に懐かしかったですね。
lines.en: Yesterday's reunion, meeting again after twenty years, was really nostalgic.
lines.style: Warm reflective tone with a soft, slightly nostalgic male voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、田中くんが堂々とスピーチしてる姿を見て、ちょっと感動しちゃいました。
lines.en: Yes, seeing Tanaka give his speech so confidently, I was a little moved.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly emotional female delivery with warm teacher cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 彼、昔はあんなに無口だったのに、人って変わるものだと改めて気づくきっかけになりましたよ。
lines.en: He used to be so quiet, so it became a chance for me to realize anew that people really do change.
lines.style: Thoughtful male tone, mid-pace, slightly impressed and reflective.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そういえば、山田先生が最近出された防災の新刊、会場でもちょっと話題になっていましたね。
lines.en: By the way, Mr. Yamada's recently released book on disaster prevention came up as a topic at the venue too.
lines.style: Bright, conversational female voice with a hint of warm interest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、サイン入りの限定特典まで用意してくださって、もらった人は大喜びでしたよ。
lines.en: Yes, he even prepared a signed limited bonus, and those who received it were really delighted.
lines.style: Cheerful male voice, slightly amused, mid-paced and friendly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あんな楽しい夜は、二度と味わえないかもしれませんね。
lines.en: A night that fun, we might never experience again.
lines.style: Soft, wistful female tone with a touch of gentle melancholy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 幹事の佐藤さんの柔軟な進行のおかげで、本当にいい会になりました。
lines.en: Thanks to Sato's flexible hosting, it really turned into a wonderful event.
lines.style: Appreciative male voice, calm and sincere, with a satisfied close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: また五年後、皆で集まれたら嬉しいですね。
lines.en: It would be lovely if we could all gather again in five years.
lines.style: Warm, hopeful female tone, soft and slightly smiling at the end.
